text.content: Test whether paired intervention ranking on action denoising error makes the policy depend causally on correctly aligned object-memory history instead of merely learning a non-collapsed memory representation.

Eight-B200 training completes 500 finite optimizer steps and saves a complete 8-rank checkpoint; aligned, zero, and shuffle branches share samples, noise, timestep, target, and non-memory conditions; zero/shuffle predictions have no gradient; zero intervention gives exactly zero object-delta main contribution; matched 2048-sample validation shows aligned main action loss at least 1% lower than both zero and shuffle. No 20k unless every gate passes.

R4 model-only warm start; R6-A dynamic-exclusive full final-delta architecture; train complete strong_action_expert; paired aligned/zero/shuffle policy branches after one shared 5B backbone pass; counterfactual branches stop-gradient; rank loss weight=1.0, relative margin=1%, warmup=50; 500 steps; batch 64/rank; DP8; matched none/zero/shuffle validation.
RoboCasa365 B4 processed split plus 1,143,698-record triple-view Wan latent cache and episode-safe t-36/t-24/t-12 visual-history sidecar; same data and held-out stream as R4/R6; no future lookup.
wam@208.64.254.190; pyrogpucompute1; cwam-b4-runtime:ngc25.09-ffmpeg6; /data0/wam/cwam-b4/env/cosmos-cu130; offline model assets.
pyrogpucompute1; 8 x NVIDIA B200 183359 MiB; batch 64 per rank; effective global batch 512.

Aligned/zero/shuffle main action losses and relative gains; ranking loss and violation fractions; effective rank weight; main context token count; applied delta RMS and ratio; slot cosine; contrastive margins; action-gradient validity; step time; GPU memory/utilization/power.

The 5B joint transformer runs once. The same pre-action hidden state is decoded through aligned, zero-memory, and shuffled-memory Action Expert branches using identical targets and diffusion conditions. Only the aligned branch receives gradients. Per sample, the new objective averages relu(L_aligned - 0.99 * stopgrad(L_zero)) and relu(L_aligned - 0.99 * stopgrad(L_shuffle)), so optimization rewards a policy whose correct temporal history is specifically useful.
